title: Benchmarking Spatial, Spectral, and Self-Supervised Cues for Face Forgery Detection under Realistic Degradation
venue: 39th Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI 2026)
abstract: A systematic benchmark assessing the generalization ability and forensic robustness of spatial convolutional representations, frequency-domain spectral maps (FFT), and self-supervised foundation models (DINOv3) for deepfake detection under real-world degradation and compression artifacts.

title: An Ensemble-Based Self-Taught Learning Approach for Parking Space Classification Under Limited Data
venue: IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
abstract: An ensemble self-taught learning framework leveraging unsupervised multi-layer autoencoders for robust visual feature extraction in intelligent parking management systems, overcoming label scarcity constraints to reach state-of-the-art accuracy on PKLot and CNR-EXT benchmarks.
